title: HaaS live output delta (run-output-delta.v1)
description: Advisory, live-only assistant text fragments sent as SSE `event: output_delta` (no `id`) on /v1/runs/{run_id}/stream?output_deltas=true when the `output-deltas.v1` capability is advertised. Deltas are never replayed and never authoritative: reset on a new (step, attempt, call) and replace with run_completed.output.

index.description: Monotonic fragment index within (step, attempt, call).

final.description: Last fragment of this model call.

truncated.description: Per-step preview cap reached; further text arrives only in run_completed.output.
